senses.gloss: f. (נָשַׁר) falling off, dropping (of fruits). Y. Macc. II, beg. 31ᶜ, v. נְשׁילָה. Y. Peah II, 20ᵃ bot. פרט בנְשִׁירָתוֹ קדש the dropping grapes are dedicated (to charity, cease to be private property) at the moment of dropping (before they reach the ground).
units: <cite ref="Yoma 2a">Ib.</cite> <he>לקט בנשירתו וכ׳</he> if one intercepts the grapes in falling &c.; Y. Ter. VI, end, 44ᵇ.
<cite ref="Yoma 2a">Ib.</cite> <he>בנשיכת פיאה וכ׳</he>, read: <he>בנְשִׁירַת פרט</he> it refers to grapes intercepted in falling.

<cite ref="Temurah 25a:36-37">Tem. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>אמר על הלקט עם נשירת רובו וכ׳</he> if he said concerning gleanings, As soon as the larger portion of them drops (before they reach the ground) they shall be free to all (<cite ref="E00759"><he>הֶפְקֵר</he></cite>); a. e.
